commits.author: Christian Ricardo
commits.message:
[Feat] [SDK-399] Add java agent for network telemetry events (#374)

* feat(java-agent): add rollbar-java-agent module skeleton

* feat(java-agent): instrument HttpURLConnection and java.net.http.HttpClient

* feat(java-agent): instrument Apache HttpClient 4.x and 5.x

* test(java-agent): add integration tests for instrumented HTTP clients

* docs(java-agent): add README with installation and manual testing guide

* chore(java-agent): upgrade wiremock to org.wiremock:wiremock:3.13.2

* refactor(java-agent): replace resetForTesting with injectable Provider<Long> in AgentTelemetryStore

* fix(java-agent): resolve checkstyle violations in rollbar-java-agent

* fix(java-agent): resolve checkstyle violations in rollbar-java-agent

* fix(rollbar-java-agent): declare explicit dependency on jar task in test

* feat(java-agent): instrument HttpClient.sendAsync() for async network telemetry

* fix(java-agent): fix Apache HC4 transformer to handle all execute() overloads safely

* fix(java-agent): fix Apache HC5 transformer to handle all execute() overloads safely

* docs: update readme of rollbar-java-agent

* style(java-agent): fix checkstyle line length violations in HC4 and HC5 instrumentation

* fix(java-agent): record full URL in HC5 instrumentation

* fix(java-agent): decouple getTelemetryTracker() from INSTANCE identity

* refactor(java-agent): rename AgentTelemetryStore.init() to initForTesting()

* fix(java-agent): disable plain jar to prevent overwriting shaded artifact

* fix(java-agent): always install HC4/HC5 transformers regardless of classloader

* feat(java-agent): capture HttpURLConnection requests that skip getResponseCode

* fix(java-agent): strip query and userinfo in UrlSanitizer fallback path

* fix(java-agent): make shadowJar the sole artifact, prevent thin jar from overwriting it

* fix(java-agent): preserve host in UrlSanitizer for underscore hostnames and @-in-path URLs

* fix(java-agent): prevent getInputStream advice recursion on connection-level failures

* fix: lint

* chore: update readme

* fix(java-agent): instrument Apache HC doExecute() to cover all execute() overloads

* fix(java-agent): bound scheme check in composeUrl to the authority position

* fix(java-agent): use raw URI components when stripping userinfo

* fix(java-agent): support current JDKs and surface instrumentation failures

* fix(java-agent): shade only Byte Buddy, not the Rollbar SDK

* chore(java-agent): drop unused byte-buddy-agent dependency

* docs(java-agent): narrow the zero code change claim to HTTP call sites

* fix(ci): exclude rollbar-java-agent on JDKs older than 17

* fix(java-agent): type Apache advice parameters as Object

* fix(java-agent): dedup connection failures on the connection

* perf(java-agent): restore the ignore-matcher defaults ByteBuddy provides

* fix(java-agent): keep Rollbar SDK types out of the agent jar

* test(java-agent): assert the reflective getAll() contract

* fix(java-agent): strip through the last '@' in the sanitizer fallback

* fix(java-agent): close two credential leaks in the sanitizer fallback

* fix(java-agent): keep one telemetry buffer per application

* fix(java-agent): attribute telemetry by who called, not by who registered

* fix(native-agent): contain per-slot and per-frame failures during capture
